CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_assignments (
	document_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	assigned_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (document_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS support_assignments (
	message_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	assigned_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (message_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES support_messages (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_notices (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	application_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	message VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	read_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_customer_notices_application_id ON customer_notices (application_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_customer_notices_customer_id ON customer_notices (customer_id)
